# ggcode

> ggcode is an open-source (MIT) AI coding agent that runs in the terminal. It reads a codebase, edits files, runs commands and ships code — with a polished TUI, resumable sessions, multi-agent support, and native desktop (macOS, Windows, Linux) and mobile (iOS, Android) apps. Written in Go by topcheer. Website: https://ggcode.dev — Chinese: https://ggcode.dev/zh/ — Source: https://github.com/topcheer/ggcode

## What it is

- An AI coding agent for the terminal (CLI), plus a desktop app and a mobile companion app that share the same sessions, tools and project memory.
- Model-agnostic: works with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi (Moonshot), GLM (Z.ai), GitHub Copilot and other OpenAI- / Anthropic-compatible endpoints; reasoning effort and tool choice are configurable per provider.
- Speaks Model Context Protocol (MCP) as a client (Cloudflare, Playwright, databases, custom tools) and A2A (agent-to-agent) protocol for delegating to other agents.
- Multi-agent: isolated sub-agents, persistent teammates on a shared task board, and LAN Chat — zero-config mDNS peer-to-peer messaging between ggcode instances on a local network.
- IM bridging: drive the agent from QQ, Telegram, Discord, Slack, Feishu (Lark), DingTalk and more.
- Permission modes from fully supervised to autopilot, with checkpoints and `/undo` to revert changes; tasks can run in isolated git worktrees.
- License: MIT. Free and open source.

## Install

- macOS / Linux: `curl -fsSL https://ggcode.dev/install.sh | bash` (no sudo, installs to ~/.local/bin)
- Windows PowerShell: `irm https://ggcode.dev/install.ps1 | iex` (no admin, installs to %LOCALAPPDATA%\ggcode\bin)
- Homebrew: `brew install topcheer/ggcode/ggcode`
- Desktop: https://ggcode.dev (macOS .dmg / .pkg, Windows .msi) — also on the Mac App Store and Microsoft Store
- Mobile: iOS https://apps.apple.com/app/ggcode-mobile/id6770855612 · Android https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=gg.ai.ggcode.mobile
